name: BONE
description: The hard inner structure of the body that gives form and support

name: BLOOD
description: The red fluid that flows through living bodies carrying life and energy

name: BRAIN
description: The organ of thought and awareness within the head; the seat of mind

name: SKIN
description: The outer covering of a living body; the surface that touches the world

name: HAIR
description: The thin strands that grow from the head and body of a living being

name: RABBIT
description: A small swift animal with long ears that lives close to the earth

name: BEE
description: A small flying creature that gathers from flowers and makes honey; works in a group

name: ANT
description: A tiny creature that builds and works together in great number; symbol of industry

name: EGG
description: The rounded vessel from which new life emerges; a beginning held in a shell

name: OIL
description: A smooth liquid that does not mix with water; used for fuel and food

name: SUGAR
description: A sweet substance drawn from plants; gives quick energy and pleasure to taste

name: SYMBOL
description: A sign that stands for something beyond itself; a form that carries meaning

name: HUMAN
description: A being capable of thought and awareness; a person who knows they exist

name: UNIT
description: A single complete thing that can be counted or measured; one part of a whole

name: DIVISION
description: The act of separating a whole into parts; a boundary drawn within

name: HILL
description: A raised area of land smaller than a mountain; a gentle rise in the earth

name: SHORE
description: The edge where land meets water; the boundary between earth and sea

name: WEEK
description: A cycle of seven days; a short repeating measure of daily time

name: ELDER
description: One who has lived long and gained wisdom through experience; a respected older person

name: FARMER
description: One who works the land to grow food; a person who tends the earth and its harvest
